chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: A single job in the San Fernando Valley and the coast-to-coast bind
summary: After a ten-week Valley engagement he finds jobs always in New York when he is in California and the reverse.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: No. There really wasn't. We once went to --- I got a call, just to give you an example of what I'm talking about, we were out there and the first time I went to California, my wife and I went to the place in the Valley - Ann---
Sherman - no - where I worked - as a single--
It was a place in the Valley - nevertheless, we lived in a little cottage nearby and you see here I had a band in California -- they called me up and said - I can use you - not my band.
Do you want to come in and work with these guys--
Which means they already had a band - they just wanted you to come in with them.

Yes. So, now, it was the expense of me sending the band back to New York and I went on to Los Angeles, it was, in the San Fernando Valley -- and I worked there for about - what - 10 weeks, I'd say. About ten weeks. And, got myself well financially but after that was over - bang - here I am again - the same old routine. And this--- I can't tell you how many times I went from Coast to Coast and if I were in California the jobs were in New York---
And, if I was in New York, the jobs came up in California. So, you just didn't know where the hell to settle down - there was no place--
